tasks.title: Fix code-level lockout causes: hook thread without message loop, unconditional uncloak, focus-stealing rollback, child-window destroy, elevated windows, all-or-nothing hotkeys
tasks.evidence: WinEvent, mouse and gesture hooks plus the tray icon now run on dedicated message-loop threads (spawn_message_loop_thread); uncloak only targets windows the daemon cloaked or DWM reports app-cloaked, and E_ACCESSDENIED on cloak falls back to moving off-screen; rollback no longer calls SetForegroundWindow; 5 consecutive apply failures pause tiling, cancel animations and run a visibility recovery pass; child-window DESTROY events no longer map to their live top-level window; windows of more privileged processes are not managed; hotkeys register partially with per-key warnings (Alt-based defaults, panic key unchanged); gestures off by default. Unit tests added for each pure part. Host validation still required (INC-49-1/4/T1).

tasks.title: Automated sandbox end-to-end test of desktop control and fixes for the defects it finds
tasks.evidence: Windows Sandbox run (networking off) of the release build: tiling at startup, Alt-hotkey walk over 10 windows, click activation without focus stealing, CLI scenario, stop recovery, hard kill + emergency-uncloak recovery, cursor latency p95 < 3 ms with mouse hooks. Fixed MoveOffScreen sentinel (-100000 clamped to -32768, never restored), startup layout, focus-follows-mouse scroll loop, foreground attach thread, display sender cleared on reload. INC-49-1/4/T1 still need confirmation on the operator desktop.
